description: Updates mutable Estimating Settings for the company. Create and Delete are not supported.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

data.description: Represents the Estimating Settings for a company.

use_metric_units.description: Indicates whether the company uses metric units for measurements.

use_unit_labor_cost.description: Indicates whether unit labor cost is used instead of hourly labor cost.

use_markup.description: Indicates whether markup is used instead of margin for profit calculations.

currency_symbol.description: The currency symbol used for monetary values.

project_stages.description: A mapping of project stages to their company-defined display names.

schema.description: Represents the mutable fields of Estimating Settings that can be updated.

use_metric_units.description: Indicates whether the company uses metric units for measurements.

use_unit_labor_cost.description: Indicates whether unit labor cost is used instead of hourly labor cost.

use_markup.description: Indicates whether markup is used instead of margin for profit calculations.

currency_symbol.description: The currency symbol used for monetary values.

project_stages.description: A partial mapping of project stages to their company-defined display names. Only the provided fields are updated; omitted fields retain their existing values.
